cohort: 114 patients (58 with previous abdominal surgery, 56 without) undergoing deep inferior epigastric perforator (DIEP) flap breast reconstruction at a single center from February 2018 to May 2024.
finding: Previous abdominal surgery (PAS) was not associated with increased complication rates at the flap and recipient-site or abdominal donor site after DIEP flap breast reconstruction.
mod_finding: Patients with a history of cesarean section had fewer flap and recipient-site complications after DIEP flap breast reconstruction.
